title: Adicch Keri Vaa
desc: Curious about what TinkerHub is? Wondering what we do, the events we host, or how you can be a part of it? Drop by for an open conversation with the TinkerHub team.No formal sessions. Just people, conversations, ideas, and a chance to connect with fellow students who love learning, building, and exploring new things. Whether you're hearing about TinkerHub for the first time or already know a little about us, you're welcome to join the conversation.
